allOf.description:
Server endpoints for the provider, keyed by API (for example `publicApi`), such as
`{ "publicApi": ["https://my-host.example.com"] }`. Whether servers are required, optional,
or not applicable depends on the provider and whether it is public. The service validates
your input and returns a descriptive error if the servers you provide aren't accepted for
the chosen provider.

aren't accepted for the chosen provider. On update, only `servers` can be changed, and only
for a private provider.
